notes: Track 0 Sec 8/9: the count == 0 producer of tax.us.2025.schedule-a.total (no Form 1098 statement on record - out of this milestone, the legacy itemized-assertion path). rule.schedule-a-total.json is the count > 0 producer of the same symbol. Splitting into two mutually-exclusive-guard rules (rather than one rule with a value-level choose over a conditionally-available ref) avoids a same-pass evaluation-order dependency on rule.schedule-a-line8a.json: this rule has no requires at all and is always immediately eligible, evaluating require_closed/count directly from committed facts/closure state, never from another rule's published output.
